source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Abdulbari,

This is exactly the direction I was hoping we'd move into.

I think we've reached the point where we've defined the architectural language of the brand, and I'm excited to see it applied to the complete VELLVÉ wordmark.

One thought occurred to me before you begin. Throughout this process we've naturally evolved toward an all-caps wordmark, but I realized I never consciously made that decision—it simply became the direction as we developed the hero V. My instinct is still that all caps is the right choice because I love the architectural rhythm it creates, especially with the hero V leading the word.

I'd love to continue down that path first. Once we see the complete wordmark together, if we feel there's a compelling reason to explore another case treatment, we certainly can. But I think it's important that we first see the architectural vision we've spent months building come together as a complete identity.

I'm really looking forward to seeing the first VELLVÉ wordmark.

value_updates.development_priority: Develop the complete all-caps wordmark first before considering another case treatment.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Hi Brittany,

Following our discussion on the unified architectural language and the all-caps direction, I am pleased to present the first integration of the full VELLVÉ wordmark.

In this layout, you will see how our approved "Anchor V" frames the beginning of the identity with that sturdy stance and confident sweep. The proprietary logic is extended to the É accent, making it an unshakeable signature.

Now that we see the complete architectural vision together, my primary focus is on refining the balance between the internal letters (E, L, L). I am actively working on the "optical rhythm," adjusting the kerning (spacing) and the width of the characters to ensure the eye flows effortlessly across the word without interruption.

This marks a true milestone for the Vellvé identity, and I'm excited to hear your thoughts on this first glimpse of the complete brand

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports presenting the first integrated full VELLVÉ wordmark following the approved all-caps direction.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Abdulbari,

After reviewing the latest presentation, I have decided to end the project. The Hero V and second V do not maintain the locked hierarchy and geometry we had established in any of these examples, despite explicit instructions.

At this stage, continuing would require reopening and reconstructing decisions that had already been resolved. I do not believe another revision cycle would be the best use of either of our time.

Please do not make any further design revisions. Please send me all editable working files created throughout the project, including the original vector/source files, presentation boards, and exported artwork in their current state.

Thank you for the time and work you have invested in the project. I wish you the best moving forward.

Brittany

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Hi Brittany,

Everything has been packaged into the final vector handoff folder (.AI, .SVG, and reference layouts).

I've sent over a request on the platform to set up/fund Milestone 3 for this final stage. Once that’s active, I'll submit the complete file package right away.

Thanks again,

Abdulbari
